intro: A frontend developer who shows impact on users: speed, accessibility and conversion, with the stack named in passing rather than listed for its own sake.
tips: Measure frontend work in what users feel: load time, accessibility, conversion.
Link to a portfolio or live product so the work can be seen.
Show collaboration with design and product, not only code.

basics.name: Tomás Herrera
basics.label: Frontend Developer
basics.summary: Frontend developer with five years building React applications for e-commerce. Rebuilt a checkout that lifted mobile conversion by 12%, and led the accessibility work that took the store to WCAG 2.1 AA.

work.name: Tienda Verde
highlights: Rebuilt checkout in React and TypeScript; mobile conversion up 12% in the first quarter.
Led the move to WCAG 2.1 AA: keyboard support, contrast and screen reader testing across 60 pages.
Created the component library six engineers and two designers now share.

work.name: Estudio Norte
highlights: Built 20+ responsive sites for retail and hospitality clients.
Introduced automated Lighthouse checks; average performance score rose from 61 to 92.
